name: Hermes
description: Nous Research's Hermes Agent CLI, driven headlessly (hermes chat -q --format stream-json). One model; questions reach the cockpit through the colonizer ask_user MCP tool.

requires.image: glibc + node >= 20 + Python 3.11 with hermes-agent v2026.9.24: git clone --depth 1 --branch v2026.9.24 https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent into a Python 3.11 venv and pip install -e ".[mcp]" (a plain pip install from git refuses by design; the mcp extra is what makes Hermes load MCP servers), leaving the `hermes` binary on PATH

model.title: Orchestrator model
model.description: The only model this agent runs on, as <provider>/<model>. It must name a provider added in Settings, which the colony reaches through the mothership's provider gateway — the key stays host-side and the colony needs no provider egress. Nous Portal models (nous/…) are refused: Portal credits are a prepaid pool the gateway cannot account for. Empty is refused too: headless Hermes has no default to fall back on.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools
disabled_tools.description: Comma-separated Hermes toolset names this colony never gets, such as web, browser or computer_use, appended (deduplicated) to the runner's always-off list in config.yaml. The names are whole toolsets: a single tool inside one (only write_file within file, say) cannot be turned off. memory, skills, delegation, cronjob, tts and clarify are always off already. Empty disables nothing beyond that.
